title: MCP Server
snippet:
> The Systeme.io MCP server is in its initial release. We’re actively improving it by adding more capabilities and strengthening stability and reliability over time.
#
Introduction
Welcome to the Systeme.io MCP Server overview. The Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an open standard designed to connect AI models with external data and tools. Our MCP server acts as a bridge between your Systeme.io account and AI-powered environments (such as ChatGPT, Claude Desktop, or other MCP-compatible clients).
By leveraging the MCP server, you can grant AI agents the ability to perform contact (contacts, tags, and contact fields) and newsletter management actions within your account using natural language commands. This integration significantly enhances productivity by bringing your contact data (contacts, tags, and fields) into the AI’s context window.
#
Getting Started
To begin using the Systeme.io MCP server, you must first obtain an MCP key. You can generate a new key by navigating to the profile settings within your Systeme.io dashboard under the ["MCP & API keys"](https://systeme.io/dashboard/profile/public-api-settings) section. Once you have your key, you can configure your MCP-compatible client to connect to our server.

Authentication
Security is a priority for our integration. To authenticate with the MCP server, you must use your MCP key. The server supports two authentication methods to provide flexibility across different MCP clients:
- **HTTP Header**: Attach your MCP key to the `X-MCP-Key` header.
- **Query Parameter**: Include your MCP key as the `mcpKey` parameter in the request URL.
This dual-method approach ensures that you can connect your AI tools even if the client has limitations on custom header configuration.
#
Supported operations
The Systeme.io MCP server currently supports **contact and newsletter management**. The following operations are available:
- **Contacts:** list, retrieve, create, update, delete
- **Tags:** list, retrieve, create, update, delete
- **Tag assignment:** assign or remove tags from contacts
- **Contact fields:** list available contact fields (field slugs)
- **Newsletters:** create, update, find and review existing ones
At this stage, these are the only capabilities exposed by the MCP server. Other Systeme.io features are not yet supported. Additional functionality may be introduced as the MCP server evolves.
#
Rate-Limiting
The MCP server adheres to the same rate-limiting policies as the Systeme.io Public API to maintain

title: How to connect your systeme.io account to ChatGPT using MCP keys
snippet:
In this article, you will learn how to integrate the systeme.io MCP server with ChatGPT so you can interact with your account data using AI.
What you will need:
- A [systeme.io](systeme.io) account
- An MCP key generated from your systeme.io account ([How to use the systeme.io MCP server (Model Context Protoco](https://help.systeme.io/article/9489-how-to-use-systeme-ios-mcp#3-How-to-generate-your-MCP-keys-usC9d)l)
- A ChatGPT account
To connect [systeme.io](http://systeme.io) to ChatGPT using an MCP key, log in to your ChatGPT account, open the left side menu, and click **Plugins** (1).

Click **Add** (2), and select **Add custom MCP server** (3).

In the setup popup, enter the following details:
- **Name (4):** [Systeme.io](http://Systeme.io) MCP
- **Description (optional) (5):** [Systeme.io](http://Systeme.io) official MCP server
- **Connection (6):** Server URL
- **Server URL (7):** [https://mcp.systeme.io/mcp?mcpKey=YOUR_KEY](https://mcp.systeme.io/mcp?mcpKey=YOUR_KEY)
> **Note:** Replace YOUR_KEY with the MCP key you created on your [systeme.io](http://systeme.io) account.
- **Authentication (8):** No Authentication
Tick the **I understand and want to continue** box (9), then click **Create as a plugin** (10).

In the "Add [Systeme.io](http://Systeme.io) MCP server to ChatGPT" window, click **Connect** (11).

title: Run your business with AI
snippet:
## What is the systeme.io MCP server?
systeme.io includes a built-in MCP server that lets you **connect AI tools like ChatGPT or Claude directly to your account**. Once connected, your AI can access your content to create and manage things like funnels, contacts, courses, and products, and even chain several actions together in a single request. Sensitive actions always require your confirmation first.

Connect your favorite AI tool in a few clicks
Generate a secure MCP key from your account settings, then use it to connect your favorite AI tool like ChatGPT or Claude

The systeme.io MCP (Model Context Protocol) server is a standard that securely connects your systeme.io account to AI assistants like ChatGPT or Claude. It allows you to interact with your business data using natural language, enabling you to build funnels, manage contacts, and create email campaigns just by typing simple commands in your chat window.
Is it safe to connect my systeme.io account to AI tools?
Yes. We prioritize your security by using a secure authentication process. When you connect via MCP, you are in control of the permissions granted to the AI. You can choose which tools the AI can access (read-only vs. write/delete) and revoke that access at any time directly from your AI provider’s settings.

The MCP server is a powerful feature included in all systeme.io plans. Whether you are on our Free, Startup, Webinar, or Unlimited plan, you can connect your account to AI tools and start leveraging the power of natural language to streamline your marketing and business management.

title: How to use the systeme.io MCP server (Model Context Protocol)
snippet:
The new MCP server feature gives users, partners, and developers a powerful new way to interact with [systeme.io](http://systeme.io) using AI tools.
## 1. What is MCP?
MCP (Model Context Protocol) is a standard that enables AI assistants (such as ChatGPT or Claude) to connect securely to external platforms.
With MCP, you can use natural language commands to interact with your [systeme.io](http://systeme.io) data. For example, you can ask ChatGPT to find a contact or add a tag just by typing a sentence.
Our MCP feature currently provides direct access to specific contact-management features, allowing you to use AI to manage your contacts, tags, and contact fields.
## 2. How does our MCP server work?
The [systeme.io](http://systeme.io) MCP server allows AI applications to access specific contact-management tools within your account.
It creates a bridge between:
- **The host**: Your AI tool (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude).
- **The server:** Your [systeme.io](http://systeme.io) account.
Once connected, the AI can execute commands to manage your contacts and tags automatically.
For technical details, please refer to our official MCP documentation: [https://developer.systeme.io/docs/mcp-server](https://developer.systeme.io/docs/mcp-server)
## 3. How to generate your MCP keys
To connect an AI tool, you first need to generate a secure MCP key.
Click on your profile picture and select **Settings** (1). In the left menu, click **MCP & API keys** (2).
![](/uploads/migrated/fa6ffd3ee9cb3003499ac29b.png)
Scroll down to the **MCP keys** section and click **Create** (3).
![](/uploads/migrated/4ff505afe8fa0edf6792b130.png)
Give your key a name, set an expiration date, and click **Save** (4).
![](/uploads/migrated/e2c25bbe0e4aa5ea0817bd8b.png)
Your key is now ready.
![](/uploads/migrated/610d82189f730fc20c51a604.png)

You can use AI tools to perform the following actions:
**a. Contact management:**
- **Create and update contacts:** Add new contacts or update existing ones.
- **Delete contacts:** Remove contacts from your list.
- **List and retrieve contacts:** Use filters to list contacts or fetch specific contact details.
- **Manage tags:** Create, assign, list, and remove tags from contacts.
- **Retrieve contact fields (custom fields):** List available contact fields and their identifiers (slugs) so the AI can correctly fill in and update contact information.

title: How to manage your automation rules and work flows with the systeme.io MCP server
snippet:
In this article, you will learn how to manage your [systeme.io](http://systeme.io) automation rules and workflows using natural language through our native MCP server. By connecting an AI tool like ChatGPT or Claude, you can easily create and retrieve simple automation rules to connect common events and actions without configuring them manually in your dashboard.

The MCP server allows you to perform basic actions on your automation rules directly from the chat. You just need to specify the trigger and the action you want the rule to execute.
**a. Create an automation rule:** You can ask the AI to generate a brand-new automation rule in your account. Currently, the MCP server supports the following specific elements:
- **Triggers:** Tags (Tag added, Tag removed), Courses (Enrolled in course, Course completed, Lecture completed, Module completed), Sales (Subscription payment failed, New sale, Sale canceled), Funnel form subscribed, Campaign completed, Booking created, and Page visited.
- **Actions:** Tags (Add a tag, Remove a tag), Courses (Enroll in course, Revoke access to course), Emails (Send email, Send email to a specific address, Subscribe to campaign, Unsubscribe from campaign), Send webhook, and Send SMS.

The MCP server allows you to build, manage, and activate automated workflows directly from the chat.

title: How to connect your systeme.io account to Claude using MCP keys
snippet:
In this article, you will learn how to integrate the [systeme.io](http://systeme.io) MCP server with Claude so you can interact with your account data using AI.
What you will need:
- A[systeme.io](http://systeme.io) account
- An MCP key generated from your [systeme.io](http://systeme.io) account ([How to use the systeme.io MCP server (Model Context Protocol](/article/9489-how-to-use-systeme-ios-mcp#3-How-to-generate-your-MCP-keys-usC9d))
- A Claude account (The feature is available for all plans)
You can connect [systeme.io](http://systeme.io) to Claude using their Connectors feature. This works on [Claude.ai](http://Claude.ai) (Web), the Claude desktop app, and Claude mobile apps.

In the setup popup, enter the following details:
- **Name** (5)**:** [systeme.io](http://systeme.io)
- **Remote MCP server URL** (6)**:** [https://mcp.systeme.io/mcp?mcpKey=YOURMCPKEY](https://mcp.systeme.io/mcp?mcpKey=YOURMCPKEY)
> **Note:** Replace YOURMCPKEY with the **MCP key you created on your** [**systeme.io**](http://systeme.io)** account.**
- **Advanced settings (optional)** (7)**:** These settings allow you to customize how Claude connects to the MCP server, such as authentication, permissions, or connection preferences. We recommend leaving these two fields empty.
Click on **Add** (8).
